SELECT fl.id, fl.shipment_no AS shipmentNo, fl.from_warehouse_id AS fromWarehouseId, fl.to_warehouse_id AS toWarehouseId, wf.wh_name AS fromWarehouseName, wt.wh_name AS toWarehouseName, fl.carrier, fl.waybill_no AS waybillNo, fl.charge_weight AS chargeWeight, fl.volume_weight AS volumeWeight, fl.freight_amount AS freightAmount, fl.currency, fl.exchange_rate AS exchangeRate, fl.freight_cny AS freightCny, fl.shipped_at AS shippedAt, fl.allocate_strategy AS allocateStrategy, fl.alloc_remark AS allocRemark, fl.allocated_at AS allocatedAt, fl.status, fl.remark, fl.created_by AS createdBy, fl.created_at AS createdAt, fl.updated_at AS updatedAt FROM first_leg_shipment fl LEFT JOIN warehouse wf ON fl.from_warehouse_id = wf.id LEFT JOIN warehouse wt ON fl.to_warehouse_id = wt.id
AND fl.shipment_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.shipmentNo}, '%')
AND fl.status = #{query.status} AND fl.from_warehouse_id = #{query.fromWarehouseId} AND fl.to_warehouse_id = #{query.toWarehouseId}
ORDER BY fl.id DESC
